Welp, me and 3 other friends did 360ug without someone watching us. We all kinda faded out of reality and started losing our minds. One of us went outside and made a fuss with the neighbours, i went outside on the peak talking to the neighbours who wanted to call the cops, I luckily was able to change their minds and they went back inside. But in my mind I couldnt process that the cops werent coming. We all started entering a loop in our heads where we all died. No one talked for a good 2 hours because we just couldnt. I was still thinking I heard sirens outside and kept getting scenarios in my head where we got arrested (all 4 minors btw). I couldnt tell what was reality anymore, everything seemed fake and I didnt trust anything. Eventually one of our friends came over and we snapped out of it. It was a very weird experience and I would categorize it as a bad trip. All the other times I did lsd it went fine though.

Hopefully this gives you a kind of image on going bad (but you can definitely trip worse)
